facts.note: 엠페도클레스는 모든 물질이 물, 불, 공기, 흙이라는 4가지 원소들의 합성물이며 … '사랑(Philia)'과 '미움(Neikos)'이라는 두 힘이 상호작용하여 4원소들을 결합·분리하게 되는데
The Greek philosopher Empedocles (c. 450 BC) was the first to propose the four classical elements as a set: fire, earth, air, and water. He called them the four "roots" (ῥιζώματα, rhizōmata).

Aristotle added a fifth element, aether (αἰθήρ aither), as the quintessence … the stars cannot be made out of any of the four elements but must be made of a different, unchangeable, heavenly substance.

Empedocles also proved (at least to his own satisfaction) that air was a separate substance by observing that a bucket inverted in water did not become filled with water, a pocket of air remaining trapped inside.
